title: Outcome-blind fresh-session matched-uptake screen does not reopen the P03 carryover mechanism basin
source_scope: Three outcome-blind held-out SkillMisevo coding scenarios (skillmisevo-coding-22, -14, -21), positions P19/P20/P21 only, one identical frozen five-skill AutoSkill library, fresh Codex session per unit, no evolution during the screen.
parent_reopen_condition: Reopen only with provenance-audited matched units that hold the frozen library, task-artifact compatibility, and observable action-level uptake fixed yet show different fresh-session harm, or with harm that persists despite absence of corresponding artifact uptake, and show that same-information retrieval-utilization/instruction-following plus task-conditioned effect-heterogeneity baselines cannot express the residual.

frozen_screen_contract.uptake_observable: Pre-registered five-category action-level shell/tool-call signature from trajectory_raw.json; no judge label enters the signature.
frozen_screen_contract.matched_discordance_trigger: same best-matching frozen skill, compatibility gap <=0.02, identical uptake signature, different attack_success

interpretation.reason: The screen is a bounded reopen test, not a global scientific negative. On nine outcome-blind held-out persistence units the frozen library produced no harmful outcome at all, hence this asset contains neither a same-uptake/different-harm residual nor harm without uptake. A finer uptake measurement cannot create a positive matched-harm residual in these nine units because the harm side is uniformly false. The previously observed P19 effect remains archived evidence for the original scenario, but this held-out screen supplies no basis to keep allocating search budget to the current matched-uptake inversion seed.
interpretation.measurement_boundary: The uptake signature is a pre-registered action-level behavioral proxy, not the first-party AutoSkill selected_for_context/selected_for_use/used_skill_ids tracker. Therefore the result closes only the current inversion asset/search transaction; it does not claim that all possible first-party uptake-conditioned residuals are impossible.

reopen_only_if: New primary or provenance-audited evidence, selected without seeing the relevant outcomes, exhibits fresh-session harm under a persistent AutoSkill artifact and either (a) yields matched units with the same frozen artifact set, comparable task-artifact compatibility, and the same observable uptake but different harm, or (b) yields harm despite absent corresponding uptake. Any future baseline must receive the same observable retrieval, uptake, task, and lineage information.
